about: Durga Puja in Magarpatta City, Pune began in 2018 at the Aditi Garden Amphitheatre. It was started by Pradyumna Das Roy, Koyeli Roy, Asish Barman, Maya Chakraborty Barman, Pulakesh Chatterjee and Subhra Chatterjee. Pradyumna, known to everyone as Prady, runs the whole operation and keeps the accounts. Asish leads the puja rituals, and Pulakesh guides the samiti as its senior mentor. Among its mainstays are the volunteers Arabinda Ghosh, Suvo Gupta, Sujan Dutta, Soumitra Ganguly, Samiran Patra, Ashok Jhawar and Mousum Dutta, with many others besides.
